findings.title: Hashing a callable's filename does not authenticate the executed callable
findings.evidence: _validate_dependencies compares the injected forward with model_type.forward, class/function names/modules and the on-disk hash of forward.__code__.co_filename. SparseTensor and the original explicit-GEMM descriptor use the same filename-hash pattern. There is no actual-code comparison to the pinned definitions or canonical dependency qualification at these boundaries. A replacement compiled with the genuine source filename and assigned to the expected class can retain the checked metadata while executing other code. The existing foreign-forward test rejects object()+lambda before exercising this case. admission.qualify_cache_type already demonstrates an AST/code comparison approach without importing native code.
findings.impact: The stated guarantee that dependency injection cannot replace the genuine learned parent forward is not established by the current validator. Hooks and receipts constrain shape/order but do not prove the parent computation itself. An immutable separately qualified worker source closure could supply this guarantee, but that concrete worker/bridge is currently absent.
findings.required_resolution: Authenticate actual forward/SparseTensor/descriptor code against the exact pinned definitions and relevant canonical dependency identities, or provide the explicit independently qualified immutable worker closure that supplies those guarantees. Add a narrow CPU-only rejection case for a foreign callable carrying the genuine source filename and expected class/module metadata; no model/native import is necessary.

source_review_passes: Profile is frozen, contains immutable canonical geometry bytes and fixed tuple supports, and is reauthenticated at consumers. A name or final count alone does not admit the brick path.

Prepared original denormalized F32 latent, I32 support, all four BF16 guide payloads, exact BF16-to-F32 expansion and geometry coordinates are authenticated by exact shape, dtype, read-only layout and payload hashes. Eight original C2S calls retain mask and coordinate/order checks.
Original strict F16/F32 model manifest is retained: 284 entries, 208 F16 and 76 F32, 948567448 runtime parameter bytes. No BF16 learned-decoder substitution is introduced.

The genuine frozen F16 row helper is loaded from exact SHA-verified bytes. It retains original weight view/transpose and addmm/mm behavior, sentinel masking and full global source indices without tile rebasing. Six large sites produce 14 tiles each, total84; final64 produces60 tiles with last24579 rows.

Native boundary retains exact five-map site/order/coordinate/default-stream/ratio2/algorithm checks and original binding wrappers. All six large sites require the same admitted global native map, coordinate object and genuine original cache object. Final64 requires its own admitted full map.

Admission preserves max(allocated,reserved)+ceil(5*additional/4)+1GiB<=12GiB and free>=ceil(5*additional/4)+2GiB, with13GiB initial free. Full-output allocation and every tile are admitted before allocation; only already-live map/hash/output terms are removed from later additional plans. Full downstream extras remain charged.

The independent source-visible retained envelope includes model, all guide/mask/coordinate families, full maps and hashes, primary/secondary feature tables, expanded parents, skip tables, projection/raw/finite buffers and optional sparse metadata. Its3230157582-byte envelope plus the largest padded additional plan and opaque allowance is8968476420 bytes; this arithmetic fit does not bound allocator fragmentation or physical free memory.

Patch always-call hooks and outer cleanup restore original descriptors after ordinary failure or cancellation, remove hooks and native wrappers, clear retained map/cache/coordinate references and collect tracked input/output tensors. Model/component/parameter and allocator-zero cleanup are explicitly caller-owned and required by validate_result; a future concrete worker must supply them.

Canonical original public ownership class/factory is shared by both private field copies while historical default globals and limits remain unchanged. No duck-typed authority is admitted. A future brick output must use a fresh exact-leaf host attestation; the old turret leaf and fixed-root output_owner helper cannot authorize it.

Profile writer and independent reader preserve original confinement, alias/single-link, exclusive-write, ownership, finite-value, unclamped F32 transform, metadata, payload hash and complete-coordinate checks. Production output requires1957891 rows and exact original final coordinate hash. The payload is125305024 bytes. Synthetic fixture mode is explicit and is rejected by neural result acceptance.
Hash-pinned private source modules avoid replacing generic historical module aliases. Tracked historical files have no diff against the approved base. No new GPU/worker CLI is introduced.
